scope: Focused deterministic VM tests of production driver runtime, generated broker/worker, and device link; no browser, model API, network, credentials, or full mission suite.
limitations: Does not reproduce the unknown real-browser scheduling cause of the V6.1 five-second timeout.
Does not certify browser CSP/Worker isolation or completion of five pick-and-place trials.

tests.name: production sample driver validates XY, lift, grip without actuation
startup and execution receive separate bounded deadlines
one encode startup failure retries with exactly one physical command
two encode startup failures exhaust recovery without transmission
encode execution timeout never retries or transmits
decode timeout preserves actual ACK, invalidates driver, and never resends
late result cannot complete a newer request or send stale movement
dispose during startup cancels pending work and prohibits recovery
dispose after successful encoding prevents the pending physical transmission
malformed ACK dry run fails when rejection is actually a runtime timeout
